entities.summary: Nile University of Nigeria (NUN) is a private multidisciplinary university established in 2009 and located in Abuja, Nigeria. It is a member of the Honoris United Universities Network and accredited by the National Universities Commission. Currently, it has eight faculties and a School of Postgraduate Studies, offering 34 undergraduate programs and 47 postgraduate programs.
